notes.title: Dev Update 2: Beware of what lurks under the ocean!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/70e036fb08db98f9c2f78b3e31b5ddaff60bdc18.png[/img]

Arrr!	

The Seadevil has been spotted roaming the ocean! Stalking the seas, this colossal predator charges through the waters leaving destruction in its wake. Sighted by few and survived by fewer, tales of its wrath serve as a warning to all who would dare challenge its rule. Beware, for those who choose to cross its path must surely have a death wish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/5253b10c03479bdc26386a1c96e6d6773bbcf45e.gif[/img]
[i]I wouldn't wanna go near him...[/i]

While the Seadevil lurks on the ocean floor, it is not the only threat that captains will need to beware of!
The seas have grown rough, and danger looms on the horizon! So hoist the sails, man the cannons, and set forth into the vast beyond!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/70986053fa68897d4f2db596ea0ca492d25ab609.png[/img]
[i]Look out for more reveals![/i]

[b]*   *   *  *   *  *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *  *   *  *   *   *   *   *   *   *  *   *  *   *   *   *   *   *   *  [/b]

Ahoy, me hearties! Project 99 here. Our first peek into Piratopia 2.0 was met with great enthusiasm, and this gives us great encouragement as we forge ahead with finding ways to make this pirate dream a reality! Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/pPk47a7u4C]Discord [/url] for more events and other exciting updates!

notes.title: All Hands on Deck: The Clan Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/427c5a9fce387c0ef8b7e998b3dffb446c5c9cde.png[/img]

[i][b]Are ye up for a string of salty challenges? [/b][/i]

“All Hands on Deck: The Clan Challenge" will be your first quest. Clan Leaders must round up their crew to compete for treasure and glory. 

Aspiring Clan Leaders must submit their Clan name by [b]23:59 GMT+8 on January 26th, 2023.[/b] through our [b][url=https://discord.gg/pPk47a7u4C]DISCORD[/url].[/b] We'll be creating channels for each submission, so if ye can't find your Clan name on the list, reach out to the admins by [b]14:00 GMT on January 27th, 2023. [/b]

Rally at least 10 Clan members to join your assigned channel by [b]23:59 GMT+8 on January 29th[/b] to complete this challenge.

Clans that manage to complete both steps above will get to reserve their clan name for Piratopia 2.0’s launch.

Keep in mind:

- Clan names will be unique and reserved for this event on a first-come-first-served basis.
- Clan names will be released if clan leaders are unable to rally enough members by the end of this challenge. 
- We reserve the right to reject offensive names, so please be nice!

[b]Interested seadogs will need to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pPk47a7u4C]DISCORD[/url] to qualify for a clan.[/b]

More information will be going out on a weekly basis, so keep an eye out for updates and prepare yourselves for the adventure of a lifetime.

Fair Winds and Calm Waters to all! ⛵

notes.title: Dev Update 1: Charting new waters in Piratopia 2.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/aa331d71a6aa0218a389e13f7a81c4663e75a9e2.png[/img]
Ahoy Mateys! 

We’re thrilled to haul out a bit of what we have been plundering and want to give you a taste of some of our creations thus far in 2022! We know your thirst for new treasures and adventures is strong, and we want to thank everyone for being so supportive and patient with us. Your trust in our pirating ways will be well rewarded! Now let us get into some updates that will include several new features that we know you will love. 

[h1]New Ship Classes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/f3e51aa730eda4b52d17d33c9a61955f747fc10f.png[/img]
With a new class-based system, you can choose to play as the Dreadnought, the imposing figure in any fleet, the Destroyer, designed to deliver massive damage with its vast array of weaponry, or the Cruiser, outmaneuvering the enemies and delivering quick successions of hit-and-run tactics. 

Players will now have a wider range of strategies and play styles to choose from which will open up new opportunities for them to take on new challenges and enjoy the game in new ways. 

[h1]The Crew System [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/a9a17bb6d68409e7c9985fb5ab9f92c1f8017d66.png[/img]
[i]Get your rum ready, they are thirsty![/i]

Players will come across various crewmates they can recruit throughout the game. By recruiting them to your ship, players will be able to access new passive and active abilities that will boost different ship skills and change the playstyle. 

Players can customize their builds with the abilities that they unlock, creating a more personalized and immersive experience. Players will be able to mix and match crewmates to create a unique and powerful crew, and set out to conquer the seas.

[h1]UI Overhaul [/h1]
Players will find a cleaner and more intuitive layout, making navigating the game easier and accessing all the features they need. We have also included new tooltips and tutorials to help new players get started. Here are some snippets of what you can expect...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/610d4635d69a93d5b255d6a1fa294038ae49b8eb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/6394e50bdc4647a93e57e835313666f4fdee9989.jpg[/img]

We're working on new content, new abilities, and new adventures.



But before we go...
Is it just us... 


[i]or is something in the waters below...?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/97d5a745808c30cb2470afb5d8aaa2102356f8d7.jpg[/img]
[Hint: Look out for the next post!]

notes.title: Public Beta #4
notes.content:
Hello Pirates!

Thank you for playing the latest beta even if it was a short one. 
I’ve received a few feedback and I’ll be making some changes and run another beta this weekend, starting from Friday 7pm BST until Monday!

This beta will contain : 
* Bigger map. There is more space between areas allowing for the red fleet to not be too close to cozy cove as well as the other smaller fleet.
* More Fleet in the map.
* Cap trading resources so it doesn’t snowball to crazy amounts of gold.
* Made 2 of the 3 Ports more accessible.
* Add Fish to Resource traders around cozy cove.
* Add Difficulty Popup alert when going into an area while being under levelled.
* Balance tweaks on certain enemies.

If everything goes fine this will be the last beta with an excepted release date in November!
Make sure to join the beta and give the final feedback in our Discord https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

Arrr Pirates!

notes.title: Public Beta #3
notes.content:
Hello Pirates, 

I'm happy to announce the third and probably last public beta will open the 1st October, 7pm BST and close Monday the 4th.

The beta contains : 
[list]
[*] Simple story and story task
[*] Trading and more materials
[*] More small NPC fleet roaming around safe zone
[*] Gold is persisted between sessions
[*] Smaller improvements on chat, power balance, enemy loot etc..
[/list]
There will be a soft reset on ship and parrot levels, that means that some levels will be subtracted based on thresholds.

See you in the open seas, Pirates!

notes.title: Public Beta #2
notes.content:
Hi Pirates, 

I'm happy to announce that the second public beta will open the 27th of August, at 7pm BST time.
The beta will remain open for 2 weeks.

The new additions are : 
[list]
[*] End game condition. Collect all the 5 rare gems in the world and claim the BMF title.
[*] Added the mythical Kraken, in fact there are 3 of them of different sizes, each dropping one gem.
[*] Player to Player trades of base crafting material.
[*] Added NPC traders close to the corners to allow ammo and crew refills before engaging with top bosses.
[*] Added intro NPC giving general direction.
[*] Added NPC that hints you where the gems are.
[*] Improved the minimap.
[*] Added more ship levels.
[*] Added a new weapon, the harpoon. It allows you to hook to terrain or ships and pull yourself.
[*] Added sound effects and music.
[*] Added nationality flags. Represent your country!
[*] General balance, bugfixes and performance improvements.
[/list]
I can't wait to meet you in the world and go on raids!
Join our community here https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

See you Pirates in the open seas! Yaarrrrr!
